title: Mi DGT counters in `dgt datos`
result: after the Cl@ve login the command loads `/es/mi_dgt/` and reads the seven `ajaxCalls.jsp?<name>=true` counters into `contadores` (5496b5d). Loading the home first is what the earlier `-`/HTML answers lacked. One live run of four missed the vehicle counter, so a field is absent rather than guessed when the DGT gives no number.
